problem: Git diff/status can conceal changed dependency files marked assume-unchanged or skip-worktree, allowing a pinned checkout validator to report false success.
invariant: Read-only pinned dependency validation must reject hidden index flags, preserve source and Git metadata, and admit only exact upstream or one reviewed patch before mutation.
evidence: scripts/worldgen/test_pcgex_bootstrap.py: eight offline actual-Git regression tests, including both hidden flags and repeated validation
do_not_copy: PCGEx commit, patch hashes, Unreal version and YACS machine paths
failure_behavior: Fail before changing the dependency when identity, index visibility, tracked/staged/untracked state or reviewed patch differs.
